provenance.asset_description: Pathfinder Second Edition Remaster: Gatewalkers Hardcover Compilation. A human woman dressed in leather and furs looks into the distance while holding a large golden amulet. Behind her is the head and shoulders of a human man with glowing purple veins, summoning purple magic in his curled hand. Even further in the background is a magical gate with an undead being and a number of tentacles storming through the gateway
